inOneSentence: An admin invites a person by e-mail, and the person joins with one click.

figure.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  admin["admin"] -- "invites" --> api["API"]
  api -- "e-mail" --> person["person"]
  person -- "accepts" --> api
figure.caption: The whole feature in one picture.

threeThings.p: Everything lives in the existing API and web app. Nothing new to run.

threeThings.t: The e-mail is sent in the request
threeThings.p: Three tries, then the invite shows as not sent. A queue is the next step if sends start failing.

threeThings.t: The link is the only key
threeThings.p: The token is stored hashed and expires in seven days.

needsYourEye.p: A failed send waits for the admin to resend. The evolution path names when to add a queue.

costPlain: Under a dollar a month today.
reviewPlain: One reviewer, one round. One finding was sustained and fixed by the conductor; none was dismissed.
